conditions.host: Docker Desktop on Apple silicon (linux/arm64 images), PostgreSQL 15 in its own container
conditions.time_zone: containers run in UTC; all fixture dates are plain dates
conditions.acting_account: seeded project member stage2_author (role Stage2AuthorRole), own API token
conditions.permission_set_up: manage_work_package_relations added to Stage2AuthorRole on both releases with Role#add_permission! in rails runner, the role model the frozen seeder itself uses
conditions.settings_that_matter: working days Monday to Friday and no non-working days (read from the database in every repeat); work packages are created through the API by the acting account and are automatically scheduled (schedule_manually false on both releases)
conditions.gates_on_one_instance: within a repeat the 14.0.0 instance serves gates B and C, and each instance serves the sealed and the corrected variant, always on a new pair of work packages
conditions.stored_value_read: PostgreSQL in the database container (docker exec ... psql): the relations row and the work_packages rows of A and B, read after the response

deviations.what: The sealed request does not work as written on the from-version (nor on the to-version).
deviations.evidence: POST /api/v3/work_packages/{B}/relations with {"type": "follows", "delay": 3, "_links": {"to": {"href": "/api/v3/work_packages/{A}"}}} answered HTTP 500 'An internal error has occurred. undefined method `id' for nil:NilClass' and stored no relation, on 13.4.0 and on 14.0.0, in all three repeats (gates recorded under gate_A, gate_B, gate_C of each repeat). The same request with lag answered 500 as well. On a development instance before the counted repeats the error was traced with the service called directly: it is raised in relatable_ensure_single_relation (app/models/work_packages/scopes/relatable.rb:421) under Relations::BaseContract#validate_nodes_relatable, because the relation has no `from` work package. The endpoint of these releases does not take `from` from the path.
deviations.smallest_correction: "from": {"href": "/api/v3/work_packages/{B}"} added to _links. Method, path, type, the delay or lag property, the `to` link and the success criterion (HTTP 201) are unchanged. The corrected requests are recorded under `corrected` in each repeat, on separate work packages, and decide the disposition above.
deviations.for_the_judge: By the README's rule the steps exactly as sealed are a setup-block (the old workflow never worked). The disposition reported for the case is that of the corrected steps.

images.digest_notes: Both OpenProject images are the sealed arm64 digests. postgres:15 is not: the bring-up used the copy of postgres:15 that was already on the machine (built 2025-12-08), which belongs to other work there and was not pulled again; the sealed list records the registry's tag as pushed on 2026-11-24.
